He served for 46 years in the Department.en: He served for 46 years in the Department of Civil Engineering at Kunsan National University, including as professor, dedicating himself to nurturing the next generation of scholars, and was awarded the Order of Service Merit with Yellow Stripes. After retirement, he pursued photography, creating works of profound philosophy and artistry centered on water and light.
He served for 46 years in the Department.hint: An earlier version of this sentence was translated as: Trabajó durante 46 años en el Departamento de Ingeniería Civil de la Universidad Nacional de Kunsan, donde fue catedrático y se dedicó a formar a las nuevas generaciones, y recibió la Orden al Mérito Civil (Franjas Amarillas). Tras jubilarse se entregó a la fotografía y creó obras de honda reflexión y sensibilidad artística en torno al agua y la luz.
